content.text: {"action":"assess","assessment":{"goal":"Add a light theme for the app while retaining the existing dark theme.","summary":"The app will default to dark mode and persist the user's manual choice indefinitely in renderer storage. Users can switch themes immediately through a labeled sun/moon icon in the top-right header of join and meeting screens or through an Appearance section near the top of the renamed Settings modal; both controls remain synchronized. Light styling applies to all interface states using neutral white and light-slate surfaces with existing blue-violet accents, while video tiles and media overlays remain dark. The rendered interface must meet WCAG AA contrast, provide visible focus states and readable controls, and use a brief color transition that respects reduced-motion preferences. Native Electron window chrome remains OS-managed."}}
